profile.headline: Front End Web Developer
profile.summary:
Heya! I'm Allyson, an enthusiastic and motivated freelance front-end developer and LaunchCode boot camp graduate. I have 1.5 years of experience in web development, as well as 7 years of combined experience in technical support, customer service, user advocacy, and writing for multiple audiences. 

I'm looking to use my skills to gain professional experience in development and help a team create and maintain impactful, customer-focused products. I enjoy creative collaboration, helping people in innovative ways, active learning, and problem-solving.

Specialties: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap, Spring Boot, technical writing and technical support, writing for different audiences, content writing, storytelling, and short- and long-form blogging.
